easyPrerequisites: Ley Druid doesn't have summoning sickness.
description:
Activate Coral Atoll by tapping it, adding {C}{C}{C}{U}{U}{U} due to Nyxbloom Ancient
Activate Ley Druid by tapping it, untapping Coral Atoll
Activate Staff of Domination's third ability by paying {3} and tapping it, untapping Ley Druid.
Activate Staff of Domination's first ability by paying {1}, untapping it.
Repeat.
